# Subway Seat for Godot

The script editor in Subway Seat: gold functions, orange keywords, sage types, avocado strings and terracotta annotations, with translucent current-line, selection and search layers so error and warning lines still show through. Godot's own interface takes its colors from a base and an accent color; the interface file for each flavor lists the values to enter under Interface › Theme.

[Godot](https://godotengine.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/godot/) · Needs Godot 4.0+

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only godot
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat.tet`](Subway%20Seat.tet) | `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/text_editor_themes/Subway Seat.tet`; that's the macOS folder; Linux: ~/.config/godot/text_editor_themes/ · Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\text_editor_themes\ |
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat-interface.txt`](subway-seat-interface.txt) | enter the values in Editor › Editor Settings › Interface › Theme |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel.tet`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel.tet) | `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/text_editor_themes/Subway Seat Tunnel.tet`; that's the macOS folder; Linux: ~/.config/godot/text_editor_themes/ · Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\text_editor_themes\ |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel-interface.txt`](subway-seat-tunnel-interface.txt) | enter the values in Editor › Editor Settings › Interface › Theme |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel.tet`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel.tet) | `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/text_editor_themes/Subway Seat Enamel.tet`; that's the macOS folder; Linux: ~/.config/godot/text_editor_themes/ · Windows: %APPDATA%\Godot\text_editor_themes\ |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel-interface.txt`](subway-seat-enamel-interface.txt) | enter the values in Editor › Editor Settings › Interface › Theme |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Editor › Editor Settings › Text Editor › Theme:

```text
Color Theme: Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Editor › Editor Settings › Text Editor › Theme:

```text
Color Theme: Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Editor › Editor Settings › Text Editor › Theme:

```text
Color Theme: Subway Seat Enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/text_editor_themes/Subway Seat.tet`.
- Delete `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/text_editor_themes/Subway Seat Tunnel.tet`.
- Delete `~/Library/Application Support/Godot/text_editor_themes/Subway Seat Enamel.tet`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
